housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of EUR 727.50 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in central Trieste; Immobiliare.it carries current Trieste rental listings. No single deposit-month norm was grounded.

banking.summary: For Intesa Sanpaolo XME Conto, a foreign resident needs an Italian tax code; online identification uses an accepted Italian ID document and may require a health card.
required_docs: Accepted Italian identification document: electronic identity card, passport or driving licence

schools.summary: The Trieste directory lists American curriculum at the International School of Trieste and the IB Diploma curriculum at UWC Adriatic.

legal_admin.summary: A newcomer establishing residence applies for Anagrafe enrolment with the Municipality of Trieste.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit an Anagrafe residence-enrolment application to the Municipality of Trieste Anagrafe and Civil Status office.

tax_finance.summary: Non-Italian citizens obtain a Codice Fiscale by presenting a valid identity document, passport or residence permit at any local Revenue Agency office.

transport.summary: Trieste urban transport is operated as Trieste Trasporti within Tpl Fvg; the 2026 ordinary monthly whole-network urban pass is EUR 39.20. Driving and healthcare rules are grounded in the official regional sources stated in their fields.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A non-EU licence holder may drive for up to one year after establishing Italian residence; after that, conversion is required and is possible only where Italy has a reciprocity agreement, provided the licence is valid and was obtained before residence. Source URL: https://www.regione.fvg.it/rafvg/cms/RAFVG/infrastrutture-lavori-pubblici/motorizzazione-civile/FOGLIA12/
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible EU newcomers staying over three months and qualifying non-EU permit holders request mandatory or voluntary SSR registration through ASUGI; Trieste health-registry services are by appointment, including at Via Lionello Stock 2. Source URL: https://asugi.sanita.fvg.it/it/servizi/dist_amm_iscriz_ssn_citt_stranieri.html
